gh pr create --title "bug: #23 - Authentication token seems to get lost mid session" --body "$(cat <<'EOF'
## Summary

Fixes issue where authentication tokens are lost mid-session, causing UI components (like contract generation modules) to disappear unexpectedly. Users previously had to refresh the page to restore functionality.

## Implementation Plan

See: `specs/20251125_bug_fix_auth_token_lost_mid_session.md`

## Changes Made

### Frontend (`frontend/src/`)

#### 1. Enhanced Token Management (`contexts/AuthContext.tsx`)
- Added token refresh mechanism with exponential backoff
- Implemented session validation checks
- Added token expiry monitoring with proactive refresh (5 min before expiry)
- Enhanced error recovery with automatic retry logic
- Added debugging logs for token lifecycle events

#### 2. Improved API Client (`api/clients/apiClient.ts`)
- Enhanced 401 error handling with automatic token refresh
- Implemented request queuing during token refresh to prevent race conditions
- Added retry logic with exponential backoff for failed requests
- Improved error context and logging

#### 3. Better Route Protection (`components/ProtectedRoute.tsx`)
- Added session validation before rendering protected routes
- Implemented automatic redirect to login on invalid sessions
- Enhanced loading states during authentication checks

#### 4. Type Safety Improvements (`types/index.ts`)
- Added `TokenRefreshResponse` type for type-safe token operations

## Issue Reference

Closes #23

## ADW Tracking

ADW ID: `097eab92`

## Testing Checklist

- [x] Token refresh works automatically before expiry
- [x] 401 errors trigger token refresh and request retry
- [x] Invalid tokens redirect to login
- [x] Session state persists across page navigation
- [x] No race conditions during concurrent API calls
- [x] Protected routes validate session before rendering
- [x] Error recovery handles network failures gracefully

## Key Technical Details

- Token refresh occurs 5 minutes before expiry
- Exponential backoff: 1s, 2s, 4s retry intervals
- Request queue prevents duplicate refresh attempts
- Session validation on route changes
- Comprehensive error logging for debugging
EOF
)" --base master
